The '''Rayless Lantern''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Pirate's Shadow]] belt in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. It was riddled with tunnels and chambers, and at one point was controlled by the [[Binayre Pirates]]. The [[Silestro Privateers]], under the leadership of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jostero]], used the Lantern as their base.
